scripts.start: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use && expo start'
scripts.android: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix CI && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use && SDK_ROOT="/mnt/c/Users/$USER/AppData/Local/Android/Sdk"; if [ ! -d "$SDK_ROOT" ]; then SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Android/Sdk"; fi; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK_ROOT" ANDROID_HOME="$SDK_ROOT"; export PATH="$SDK_ROOT/emulator:$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools:$PATH"; expo start --android'
scripts.emulator: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix CI && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use && SDK_ROOT="/mnt/c/Users/$USER/AppData/Local/Android/Sdk"; if [ ! -d "$SDK_ROOT" ]; then SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Android/Sdk"; fi; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK_ROOT" ANDROID_HOME="$SDK_ROOT"; export PATH="$SDK_ROOT/emulator:$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools:$PATH"; emulator -avd Medium_Phone_API_36.1'
scripts.ios: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use && expo start --ios'
scripts.web: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use && expo start --web'
